coverage: Named hospital sites, scoped major university/college campuses, municipal halls and public library branches mapped in OpenStreetMap inside the Metro Vancouver-area rectangle, with reviewed official campus additions. This is a regional source inventory, not an exhaustive facility directory.

scope_evidence.supports: BC public institution identities; not a campus location or operating-status verification

limitations: DATA_DATE is the actual OSM snapshot download date; OSM_TIMESTAMP is an object edit date. Neither establishes current operation. Community points receive no CHECKED_DATE. Official additions retain their actual source-review CHECKED_DATE, independent of later OSM refreshes.
The rectangle includes parts of neighbouring communities and is not an administrative Metro Vancouver boundary. Missing, stale or miscoded OSM features remain possible.

University is the existing UI category for university/college campuses. The explicit institution scope omits most private career/language schools, departments and individual academic buildings. It is not a complete higher-education directory.

Community campus addresses are kept as mapped. Some generic campus names are clarified using linked official directories, with the original preserved as OSM_NAME. Two official additions supply SFU Harbour Centre and BCIT Annacis Island, giving all five named BCIT campuses and the main SFU Burnaby, Surrey and Vancouver campuses. Missing sites can still include JIBC satellites and institutions without the queried OSM tags; no claim that every major campus is included.

Civic destination covers public-library branches and main municipal halls. Academic/school libraries, heritage/event halls, municipal annexes, regional offices and First Nation administration offices are outside this specific inventory scope.

Hospital covers named hospital sites, including the forensic hospital and the shared Children’s/Women’s site. Clinics, emergency entrances and a separately named addiction/mental-health treatment centre are excluded. Inclusion does not establish emergency access or available services.

Community addresses and city labels are copied only when present in OSM; blank cities are not inferred from coordinates. Official supplements use published addresses and BC geocoder parcel points. Bounding-box centres can be far from a campus or hospital entrance; straight-line distance is to that reference point.
Known inactive tags and duplicates are screened, but current hours, access, closure status and completeness are not individually operator-verified. Nearest means nearest retained inventory point.

refresh_policy: One bounded POST, no automatic retries, no runtime visitor queries. Errors, missing timestamps, partial source remarks and anomalous counts preserve published outputs. Review category scope, official matches and static campus supplements in the script after refresh. Online OSM refresh does not re-verify or re-date official additions.
